parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is a switch handle of the faucet made of stainless steel, used to control water flow.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature or flow rate.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or lifts to open and close the water valve.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is another switch handle of the faucet made of stainless steel, typically used for hot or cold water control.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the flow of either hot or cold water, allowing temperature adjustment.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or lifts to regulate water flow.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is a base frame part of the faucet that supports the spout and connects it to the sink.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural stability and seals the faucet to the sink surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water stream from the faucet to the sink basin.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel or remain fixed depending on the faucet design.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main arched frame of the faucet that supports the spout structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main body for water flow and connects the spout to the base.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is another base frame part of the faucet that supports one of the switch handles.
parts.Functional_description: It anchors the handle assembly to the sink and ensures stability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during use.
